contract: A23-109 server (contract with 게임성 개발 1, Config.QuickSlots read only): data.QuickSlots = "<i1>,<i2>,<i3>" (Config.QuickSlots.Items keys HP / MP, "" = empty; additive, Version 3, written only when the player changes a slot); a missing / broken value is Config.QuickSlots.Default (HP, MP, empty); a stored value is cleaned at PlayerReady (unknown items and repeats empty, extra parts dropped, > 120 chars = Default). The owner's attribute QuickSlots = the same text, set at PlayerReady and after every accepted change; the client's QuickSlots.Parse reads it the same. c->s SetQuickSlot(slot 1..3 integer, item key | ""): the item already in another slot swaps with this slot's; the same item on its own slot / emptying an empty slot = no change; bad or extra args, not ready, left, no data, faster than Config.RateLimits.SetQuickSlot (0.2 s): nothing, no notice. QuickSlotService.Changed(player, slots) after every accepted change; Get(player); Parse(value). A slot press stays the UsePotion remote (VitalsService, unchanged).
limitations: Offline doubles: Players / attributes, a PlayerService double (data rows, IsReady, PlayerReady); the real DataService save is not run (the field is a plain string in the saved table). The slots on screen, keys, the bag rows (게임성 개발 1) and the KO1 quest (게임성 개발 3) are not certified here; a live Studio play is still needed.
